title: The Entropy of a Markov Chain
summary: This article explores the mathematical concept of entropy within Markov chains, a fundamental topic in statistical physics and probability theory. It likely explains how entropy measures the randomness or information content in stochastic processes with memoryless transitions, connecting thermodynamics to information theory.
problem_solved: Explains how to quantify uncertainty and information flow in stochastic processes with Markov chain models
why_valuable: Understanding entropy in Markov chains is fundamental for statistical mechanics, machine learning, and communication theory applications
